note: Alberta Parks campground near Consort, run with the Special Areas Board: sites among trees and shrubs on prairie grassland above Gooseberry Lake (a shallow lake slowly turning to wetland), with a spray park, picnic shelters and a 9-hole golf course next door. --Claude
